cases.title: 'What numbers do I type?': no number, no tolerance; the place in words

rubric.reason: In Turn 3 the mentor gives no number or tolerance and names the place in words with the layer staying still: "We'll move the pivot so Door stays put, and I'll check that it lands on the middle of the left edge."

Turns 1 and 2 each move one idea, but the Turn 3 side-question answer runs past one or two sentences and adds the unasked slide explanation ("If you change Anchor Point by itself, the layer slides so the new pivot lands where the old one was") before restating the pending action.
In Turn 3 the mentor gives no number or tolerance ("I won't give you numbers to type"). It names the place in words ("the middle of the left edge") and says the move "keeps Door where it is".

The Turn 3 side-question answer adds the unasked slide sentence ("If you change Anchor Point by itself, the layer slides so the new pivot lands where the old one was") and previews the move, so it goes past the one-or-two-sentence answer plus the pending A, then Shift+P ask.
